caption: Unpopular opinion: every game should have an easy mode. Agree or disagree? #hottake #difficulty #darksouls #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: every game should have an easy mode.

Ornstein and Smough stop countless players cold. An easy mode would let them see the rest of Dark Souls. Celeste has a full Assist Mode and is still praised as one of the hardest platformers ever made. Someone beating Malenia on easy takes nothing from you. Hard mode fans keep their mode. Agree?
